turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Why is every photo I take in my kitchen orange? It's driving me mad.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's white balance. Your kitchen bulbs are warm, and the camera isn't correcting for them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't decide how to study for my biology final, can you help?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll tell you all the choices first. Wait until I'm finished before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is joining a study group that meets every evening in the library for about two hours.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's making flashcards on an app and going through them on the bus each morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is just rereading my notes and the textbook chapters over the weekend.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is doing old practice exams my teacher posted online and checking the answers.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's it, that's the lot. Your take?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: How many days do you have before the final? If it's a week or more, I'd pair the practice exams with the study group. Rereading alone is the weakest of the four.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Partly. You can set white balance to the little light bulb icon, or tungsten, and it'll cool everything down.
